	/** The column set the new version exposes: the previous version's when left out, none for `"none"`. */
	readonly exposes?: ColumnSet | "none";
};

## evolveTable  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * Appends the next version (`previous.version + 1`) with the edits `edit` makes; `edit` must return the editor it was
 * given. Every version is materialized and fingerprinted here; the object serves the newest, and its activation
 * migrates a store at an older version through each one.
 */
export function evolveTable<
	C extends Columns,
	K extends readonly string[],
	V extends number,
	E extends { readonly "~columns"?: Columns; readonly "~key"?: readonly string[] },
>(
	previous: TableDefinition<C, K, V>,
	edit: (t: TableEditor<C, K>) => E,
	options: EvolveOptions = {},
): TableDefinition<NonNullable<E["~columns"]>, NonNullable<E["~key"]>, Next<V>>

## JsonNames  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableEditor
type JsonNames<C extends Columns> = { [P in keyof C]: ColumnTypeOf<C[P]> extends "json" ? P : never }[keyof C] & string;

## Next  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via evolveTable
/** `V + 1` for a literal version (contracts' `Increment<N>`); `number` stays `number`. */
type Next<V extends number> = number extends V
	? number
	: `${Increment<`${V}`>}` extends `${infer N extends number}`
		? N
		: number;

## PatchOf  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A `rows` patch: new values of non-key columns; `undefined` clears an `opt(...)` one. */
export type PatchOf<C extends Columns, K extends readonly string[]> = {
	readonly [P in Exclude<keyof C & string, K[number]>]?: ValueOf<C[P]>;
};

## Renamed  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableEditor
type Renamed<C extends Columns, F extends keyof C, T extends string> = {
	readonly [P in keyof C as P extends F ? T : P]: C[P];
};

## RenamedKey  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableEditor
type RenamedKey<K extends readonly string[], F, T extends string> = {
	readonly [I in keyof K]: K[I] extends F ? T : K[I];
};

## TableEditor  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The editor `evolveTable`'s edit gets: every edit; the column edits only before the data step. */
export interface TableEditor<C extends Columns, K extends readonly string[]> extends TableTailEditor<C, K> {
	/** Renames a column; the key, the indexes and a `json(...)` column's version column follow. */
	rename<F extends keyof C & string, T extends string>(
		from: F,
		to: T,
	): TableEditor<Renamed<C, F, T>, RenamedKey<K, F, T>>;
	/** Adds a column: `opt(...)`, or a scalar one with a `default` (existing rows get it). */
	add<N extends string, S extends AddedColumn>(name: N, column: S): TableEditor<With<C, N, S>, K>;
	/** A `json(...)` column's new version (its nullability kept): no DDL, no data step, cells migrate on access. */
	json<N extends JsonNames<C>, S extends ColumnSchema>(name: N, column: S): TableEditor<WithJson<C, N, S>, K>;
	/**
	 * The data step: `patch` gets each row as the columns stand here and returns new values of non-key columns (`{}`
	 * stamps the row only); synchronous and pure, run in chunks of 100 in key order.
	 */
	rows(patch: (row: RowOf<C>) => PatchOf<C, K>): TableTailEditor<C, K>;
	/** The data step as one `updateWhere` over the rows not migrated yet. */
	update(step: {
		readonly where?: (row: ColumnRefs<C>) => Condition;
		readonly set: SetOf<C, K> | ((row: ColumnRefs<C>) => SetOf<C, K>);
	}): TableTailEditor<C, K>;
}

## TableTailEditor  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The edits after the data step: `drop`, `index` and `dropIndex`; `C` and `K` are the columns and key so far. */
export interface TableTailEditor<C extends Columns, K extends readonly string[]> {
	/** Drops a non-key column; its indexes are dropped first, in the same commit. */
	drop<N extends Exclude<keyof C & string, K[number]>>(name: N): TableTailEditor<Without<C, N>, K>;
	/** Adds an index (`[a-z0-9_]+`) over non-`opt` `str` or `int` columns; it ends with the key. */
	index(name: string, columns: readonly OrderColumn<C>[]): TableTailEditor<C, K>;
	/** Drops an index. */
	dropIndex(name: string): TableTailEditor<C, K>;
	/** Type only: the columns and key so far. */
	readonly "~columns"?: C;
	readonly "~key"?: K;
}

## With  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableEditor
type With<C extends Columns, N extends string, S extends ColumnSchema> = {
	readonly [P in keyof C | N]: P extends N ? S : C[P & keyof C];
};

## WithJson  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts

type WithJson<C extends Columns, N extends keyof C & string, S extends ColumnSchema> = With<
	C,
	N,
	C[N] extends Optional ? Optional<Exclude<S, Optional | HostColumnSchema<KindShape>>> : S
>;

## Without  chord/src/store/table-evolve.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableTailEditor
type Without<C extends Columns, N extends keyof C> = { readonly [P in Exclude<keyof C, N>]: C[P] };

## Table  chord/src/store/table-handle.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A table of this object: reads of committed state, the context last. Writes go through `self.tx`. */
export interface Table<C extends Columns, K extends readonly string[]> {
	/** Up to `limit` rows of `q` (after `options.after`), and the cursor of the next page when there is one. */
	page(q: Query<C, K>, limit: number, context: Context, options?: PageOptions): Promise<Page<RowOf<C>>>;
	/** Every row of `q`, read a page of 100 at a time. */
	rows(q: Query<C, K>, context: Context): AsyncIterable<RowOf<C>>;
	/** The row with `key`, `undefined` when absent. */
	get(key: KeyOf<C, K>, context: Context): Promise<RowOf<C> | undefined>;
	/** The number of rows of `q`. */
	count(q: Query<C, K>, context: Context): Promise<number>;
}

## TableWrite  chord/src/store/table-writes.ts
used by: chord-effect via OwnerTable
/** The table writes as the outbox and archives record them. */
export type TableWrite =
	| {
			readonly kind: "table";
			readonly table: string;
			readonly version: number;
			readonly state: "ready" | "migrating";
			readonly columns: { readonly [name: string]: ColumnRecord };
			readonly key: readonly string[];
			readonly fingerprint: string;
	  }
	| { readonly kind: "index"; readonly table: string; readonly name: string; readonly columns: readonly string[] }
	| { readonly kind: "dropIndex"; readonly table: string; readonly name: string }
	/** A column edit of the migration to `version`; DDL rendered from it. */
	| { readonly kind: "alter"; readonly table: string; readonly version: number; readonly edit: AlterEdit }
	| {
			readonly kind: "put";
			readonly table: string;
			readonly row: StoredRow;
			/** The row's eager-step version (the table's version at the `put`). */
			readonly version: number;
			readonly columns: ColumnVersions;
	  }
	| {
			readonly kind: "update";
			readonly table: string;
			readonly key: StoredKey;
			readonly set: SetNode;
			readonly columns: ColumnVersions;
			readonly count: number;
			/** A migration's data step: the version it stamps as the row's `$v` (a plugin's `update` never does). */
			readonly version?: number;
	  }
	| { readonly kind: "delete"; readonly table: string; readonly key: StoredKey; readonly count: number }
	| {
			readonly kind: "updateWhere";
			readonly table: string;
			readonly where: WhereNode;
			readonly set: SetNode;
			readonly columns: ColumnVersions;
			readonly count: number;
			/** A migration's `update` step: the version it stamps as the rows' `$v`. */
			readonly version?: number;
	  }
	| { readonly kind: "deleteWhere"; readonly table: string; readonly where: WhereNode; readonly count: number };

## defineTable  chord/src/store/table.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * Declares a table: a base version written in full, the first of its history. Later versions come from
 * `evolveTable`; a new base starts a new history.
 */
export function defineTable<C extends Columns, const K extends readonly OrderColumn<C>[], const V extends number>(
	name: string,
	options: TableOptions<C, K, V>,
): TableDefinition<C, K, V>

## Evolution  chord/src/store/table.ts
used by: chord-effect via TableDefinition
/** How a version came about: the version before it and the migration from there, for one `evolveTable`. */
export type Evolution = { readonly previous: TableDefinition; readonly migration: Migration };

## KeyOf  chord/src/store/table.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The key of a row of a table with columns `C` and key `K`: an object with exactly the key columns. */
export type KeyOf<C extends Columns, K extends readonly string[]> = {
	readonly [P in K[number]]: P extends keyof C
		? C[P] extends HostColumnSchema<infer H extends KindShape>
			? Address<H>
			: C[P] extends { readonly type: "integer" }
				? number
				: string
		: never;
};

## TableDefinition  chord/src/store/table.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * A declared table at one version: its columns in declaration order, key, indexes (declared columns; the key is
 * appended when they are rendered), the fingerprint of all of it and the row codec. `C` and `K` type its rows and keys,
 * `V` its version.
 */
export class TableDefinition<
	C extends Columns = Columns,
	K extends readonly string[] = readonly string[],
	V extends number = number,
> {
	readonly name: string
	readonly version: V
	/** The column schemas as declared, which `evolveTable` edits into the next version's. */
	readonly schemas: Columns
	readonly columns: readonly Column[]
	readonly byName: ReadonlyMap<string, Column>
	readonly key: readonly string[]
	readonly indexes: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>
	/** `hash64` of the columns, key and indexes in `TABLE_FORM_VERSION`'s form. */
	readonly fingerprint: string
	/** The columns as the `table` write records them. */
	readonly record: { readonly [name: string]: ColumnRecord }
	readonly rows: RowCodec
	/** One reference per column, for the `(t) => …` callbacks of queries and writes. */
	readonly refs: { readonly [column: string]: ColumnRef }
	/** Its `host(...)` column, if it has one: its rows belong to hosts of that column's kind. */
	readonly hostColumn: HostColumnOf | undefined
	/** The version before this one and the migration from it; `undefined` for a base. */
	readonly evolution: Evolution | undefined
	/** The column set this version exposes to other plugins, if any (not part of the fingerprint). */
	readonly exposes: ColumnSet | undefined
	/** Type only: the columns and key. */
	declare readonly "~columns"?: C
	declare readonly "~key"?: K
	constructor(name: string, options: TableOptions<C, K & readonly OrderColumn<C>[], V>, evolution?: Evolution)
	/** The column `name`; an unknown one throws (`what` names the use). */
	column(name: string, what: string): Column
}

## TableOptions  chord/src/store/table.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** What `defineTable` takes. */
export type TableOptions<C extends Columns, K extends readonly OrderColumn<C>[], V extends number = number> = {
	/** The table's version: a positive integer, raised by every change (`evolveTable`). */
	readonly version: V;
	readonly columns: C;
	/** The primary key's columns, non-`opt` `str` or `int` ones. */
	readonly key: K;
	/** Secondary indexes by name (`[a-z0-9_]+`); each ends with the primary key. */
	readonly indexes?: { readonly [name: string]: readonly OrderColumn<C>[] };
	/** The column set other plugins read this table through (slice 14 §5): its columns spread into `columns`. */
	readonly exposes?: ColumnSet;
};

## Client  chord/src/surfaces/client.ts

## ClientError  chord/src/surfaces/client.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * What a client reports: its host's errors, plugins left out at a load or kept old at a reload, a failed update, a
 * plugin's stylesheet that did not load (`error`) or not within 10 s (`timeout`; this does not itself prevent the
 * plugin's new code).
 */
export type ClientError =
	| { readonly kind: "host"; readonly error: HostError }
	| { readonly kind: "plugins"; readonly failed: readonly PluginFailure[] }
	| { readonly kind: "update_failed"; readonly error: unknown }
	| {
			readonly kind: "stylesheet_failed";
			readonly plugin: string;
			readonly url: string;
			readonly reason: "error" | "timeout";
	  }
	/** A message rendered by a fallback, a contributed message that threw, a foreign message (each once). */
	| { readonly kind: "messages"; readonly report: MessagesReport };

## ClientOptions  chord/src/surfaces/client.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** What `startClient` takes. */
export type ClientOptions<P extends Principal> = {
	/** The kind's scripts object (`WebScripts`, `TuiScripts`). */
	readonly scripts: ScriptsContract;
	/** The hash of the base bundle this client runs. */
	readonly base: string;
	/** The plugin scripts it started with (the combined file's), in any order. */
	readonly initial: readonly RegisteredScript[];
	/** The modules its plugin scripts import, by specifier. */
	readonly modules: ClientModules;
	/** The app's own facets, loaded with the plugins. */
	readonly core: readonly PluginFacet<P>[];
	/** Opens one socket to the server and its link; the socket reports to `events`. */
	readonly open: (events: SocketEvents) => Link;
	/** The limits per part of what arrives from the server (default: an untrusted link's, 16 MiB on the wire). */
	readonly limits?: PartLimits;
	/** Fetches a plugin's script of a set (at its `url`), which registers itself. */
	readonly fetchScript: (entry: ScriptEntry) => Promise<RegisteredScript>;
	/**
	 * The server's current base bundle hash, asked at each reconnect beside the next attempt (`undefined`: unknown, try
	 * again): another one means this client is outdated (a new protocol comes with a new base bundle).
	 */
	readonly serverBase: () => Promise<string | undefined>;
	/** This client's code is outdated: the app starts it over (a page reloads); the loop has stopped. */
	readonly outdated: () => void;
	/** Asked at each reconnect, beside the next attempt; `false` stops the loop (a guest's ended share). */
	readonly canRetry?: () => Promise<boolean>;
	readonly onConnection?: (state: ConnectionState) => void;
	/** The plugins' stylesheets (a page's; a terminal has none). */
	readonly styles?: ClientStyles;
	readonly environment: LoopEnvironment;
	/**
	 * Makes the host's telemetry adapter (none: NOOP); `incarnation` names the host's run (it is read at the adapter's
	 * first span, after the host was made).
	 */
	readonly telemetry?: (incarnation: () => string) => TelemetryContext;
	/**
	 * Whether the client follows the scripts object (new sets applied, another base `outdated`, the server's base asked
	 * at each reconnect): yes by default; `false` for a static client (a page built offline and served elsewhere).
	 */
	readonly follow?: boolean;
	readonly onError: (error: ClientError) => void;
};

## ClientStyles  chord/src/surfaces/client.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * A page's plugin stylesheets around each update: `prepare` before the host reloads, `settle` after it (or alone when
 * no script changed).
 */
export type ClientStyles = {
	/**
	 * Fetches, without applying them, the stylesheets of `set` that differ from those of the code each plugin runs or
	 * did not load; resolves once each loaded, failed or waited 10 s, or when `signal` aborts (the client stops: what it
	 * prepared is removed, `settle` never follows).
	 */
	prepare(set: ScriptSet, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
	/**
	 * Applies each prepared stylesheet whose plugin runs its new code now and retires the one it replaces; a plugin that
	 * `kept` names (its new script failed: it kept its old code) keeps its old one, its prepared one dropped unapplied;
	 * the stylesheets of plugins no longer in `set` go.
	 */
	settle(set: ScriptSet, kept: ReadonlySet<string>): void;
};

used by: chord-effect

 * Starts a client: its host loaded with the initial scripts, its link kept, its plugins kept current from the scripts
 * object once the server answers (resolving before: a client starts offline).
 */
export async function startClient<P extends Principal>(options: ClientOptions<P>): Promise<Client<P>>

## LoopEnvironment  chord/src/surfaces/connection.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** What the loop runs in: the clock, timers, whether the device is online, and its wake events. */
export interface LoopEnvironment {
	now(): number;
	/** Runs `callback` after `ms`; returns its cancel. */
	after(ms: number, callback: () => void): () => void;
	/** `false` when the device is known to be offline. */
	online(): boolean;
	/** Calls `listener` when the client may have been away (visible again, online, network changed); returns its removal. */
	onWake(listener: () => void): () => void;
}

## LoopLink  chord/src/surfaces/connection.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** One attempt's connection as the loop sees it: it closes once, and closing it ends it at once. */
export interface LoopLink {

	close(): void;
}

## LoopOptions  chord/src/surfaces/connection.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** What the loop takes. */
export type LoopOptions = {
	/** Opens one socket and its link; the socket reports to `events`. */
	readonly open: (events: SocketEvents) => LoopLink;
	readonly onState: (state: ConnectionState) => void;
	/**
	 * Asked after a close, while the next attempt goes ahead, one question at a time (closes while one is open ask
	 * nothing more); `false` stops the loop (and closes that attempt). A rejection counts as `true` (unreachable, try
	 * again).
	 */
	readonly canRetry: () => Promise<boolean>;
	readonly environment: LoopEnvironment;
};

## MessagesReport  chord/src/surfaces/language.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** What rendering reports: a key found only further down the chain, a contributed message that threw, a foreign message. */
export type MessagesReport =
	| {
			readonly kind: "fallback";
			readonly namespace: string;
			readonly locale: string;
			readonly key: string;
			/** The locale whose catalog had the key; `undefined`: the namespace's first catalog. */
			readonly used: string | undefined;
	  }
	| {
			readonly kind: "failed";
			readonly namespace: string;
			readonly locale: string;
			readonly key: string;
			/** The contributing plugin; `undefined`: the namespace's own catalogs (a message from a link that does not fit). */
			readonly plugin: string | undefined;
			readonly error: unknown;
	  }
	/** `t.render` got a message of another namespace or a key the catalogs do not have: it shows the key. */
	| { readonly kind: "unknown"; readonly namespace: string; readonly key: string; readonly expected: string };

## LoadedFacets  chord/src/surfaces/loaded.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A host's loaded plugins: its core facets, each plugin's loaded facet, and its reloads, one after another. */
export class LoadedFacets {
	/**
	 * Prepares `entries` and loads them on `host` with `core` (the app's own facets): a plugin whose script failed is left
	 * out and reported in the report's `failed`, with the host's own. The host's loaded plugins, and the report.
	 */
	static async load<P extends Principal>(
		host: Host<P>,
		core: readonly PluginFacet<P>[],
		entries: readonly SetEntry[],
		context: Context,
	): Promise<{ readonly loaded: LoadedFacets; readonly report: LoadReport }>
	/**
	 * Reloads `host` with `entries`, the complete set now, after its earlier reloads: core facets and unchanged plugins as
	 * the same objects, new scripts prepared, a plugin whose script failed passed as its loaded facet (an added one left
	 * out; both named to the host's closure rule), plugins not in `entries` left out. What the host committed becomes
	 * the loaded set, also when the reload rejects `aborted` after its commit.
	 */
	reload<P extends Principal>(host: Host<P>, entries: readonly SetEntry[], context: Context): Promise<ReloadReport>
}

## defineMessages  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts

 * The messages of `namespace` (a name like a type's, `[a-z0-9@/._~-]`) in `catalogs` by locale; the first catalog

## MessageArgs  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The arguments of a message: its function's parameters, none for a text. */
export type MessageArgs<V> = V extends (...args: infer A) => string ? A : [];

## MessageData  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * A message as data: its namespace, its key and its parameters; typed by `t.message` (`MessageData<"notes", "saved">`),
 * any namespace and key as `MessageSchema` carries it across a link. (`Message` is the link protocol's.)
 */
export type MessageData<N extends string = string, K extends string = string> = {
	readonly namespace: N;
	readonly key: K;
	// Not a readonly array: a message goes into documents, whose drafts are mutable (immutable by convention).
	readonly params: MessageParam[];
};

## MessageParam  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A parameter of a message as data: plain JSON (a date as an ISO string or a number), so it crosses links. */
export type MessageParam = string | number | boolean | null;

## Messages  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A plugin's messages: `t` itself (in the current language), its namespace, its catalogs as contributions, `message`. */
export type Messages<N extends string, M> = Translator<N, M> & {
	readonly namespace: N;
	/** Its catalogs as `Translations` entries: a facet that renders contributes them. */
	readonly translations: readonly Translation[];
	/** The message `key` with its arguments as data, for state that clients render. */
	message<K extends DataKeys<M>>(key: K, ...args: MessageArgs<M[K]>): MessageData<N, K>;
	/** `t` in `language` (`undefined`: the first catalog). */
	in(language: Language | undefined): Translator<N, M>;
};

## MessageSchema  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The schema of a message as data, for contract members (`notice: union([MessageSchema, nul()])`). */
export const MessageSchema: Schema<{ namespace: string; key: string; params: (string | number | boolean | null)[]; }>

## MessagesOf  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The catalog shape of a plugin's messages: what a translation fills (`const fr: MessagesOf<typeof t> = {...}`). */
export type MessagesOf<T> = T extends Messages<string, infer M> ? M : never;

## MessageValue  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts

/** A message's value: a text, or a function of its arguments returning one. */
export type MessageValue = string | ((...args: never[]) => string);

## OfNamespace  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect via Translator
/** A message of namespace `N`, or one of any namespace (`string`, from a schema): another literal namespace is refused. */
type OfNamespace<G extends MessageData, N extends string> = string extends G["namespace"]
	? unknown
	: { readonly namespace: N };

## Translator  chord/src/surfaces/messages.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** Renders the messages of namespace `N` with catalog shape `M` in one language. */
export type Translator<N extends string, M> = {
	/** The message `key` with its arguments. */
	<K extends keyof M & string>(key: K, ...args: MessageArgs<M[K]>): string;
	/** A message as data; a foreign namespace or an unknown key shows the key (and is reported). */
	render<G extends MessageData>(message: G & OfNamespace<G, N>): string;
};

## PageState  chord/src/surfaces/page-state.ts
used by: chord-effect via hostLanguage
/** One key's value in a host's page state. Its functions are bound: React's `useSyncExternalStore` takes them as is. */
export type PageState<T> = {
	/** The value now. */
	readonly read: () => T;
	/** Sets the value; a new value (by identity) calls every subscriber. */
	readonly set: (value: T) => void;
	/** Calls `changed` after every set that changed the value, until the returned unsubscribe. */
	readonly subscribe: (changed: () => void) => () => void;
};

/**

export type ScriptSet = Static<typeof ScriptSet>;

## TuiScripts  chord/src/surfaces/scripts.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The current terminal scripts (`ScriptSet`), served by the server's terminal surface as `WebScripts` is. */
export const TuiScripts: Contract<{ kind: "remote"; name: "chord.tui.scripts"; params: {}; history: [{ version: "1"; variants: RemoteVariants<{ readonly main: { readonly state: { readonly set: Schema<{ base: string; combined: string; plugins: { name: string; digest: string; url: string; css?: string | undefined; }[]; }>; }; }; }>; changes: never; }]; }>

export const WebScripts: Contract<{ kind: "remote"; name: "chord.web.scripts"; params: {}; history: [{ version: "1"; variants: RemoteVariants<{ readonly main: { readonly state: { readonly set: Schema<{ base: string; combined: string; plugins: { name: string; digest: string; url: string; css?: string | undefined; }[]; }>; }; }; }>; changes: never; }]; }>

## ThemeChoice  chord/src/surfaces/theme-choice.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The caller's theme choice, on the server: its pick, and `choose` to change it. */
export const ThemeChoice: Contract<{ kind: "remote"; name: "chord.themes.choice"; params: {}; history: [{ version: "1"; variants: RemoteVariants<{ readonly main: { readonly state: { readonly pick: Schema<{ dark: string | null; light: string | null; }>; }; readonly methods: { readonly choose: Method<Schema<{ dark: string | null; light: string | null; }>, NullSchema>; }; }; }>; changes: never; }]; }>

## activeTheme  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The active theme for `mode`: the one `pick` names if contributed, else the first of that mode, else the fallback. */
export function activeTheme(themes: readonly Theme[], pick: ThemePick, mode: Theme["mode"]): Theme

## BASE_ROLES  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The roles every theme names: the kit's base set. Apps add their own roles; themes fill at least these. */
export const BASE_ROLES = ["accent", "bg", "fg", "muted", "error", "warning", "success"] as const

## BaseRole  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A base role. */
export type BaseRole = (typeof BASE_ROLES)[number];

## ColorDepth  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** How many colours a terminal shows. */
export type ColorDepth = "truecolor" | "256";

## FALLBACK_THEMES  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The theme used when no plugin contributed one of a mode: neutral colours. */
export const FALLBACK_THEMES: Readonly<Record<Theme["mode"], Theme>>

## terminalColor  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * The SGR parameters of `role`'s colour in `theme` for a terminal of `depth` (`38;2;r;g;b`, `38;5;n`; `48;…` for a
 * background): the role's `tui` override first, else its colour, else the fallback theme's; a `#rrggbb` colour is the
 * nearest of the 256 xterm colours on a 256-colour terminal. A role nobody defines, or a colour that is no `#rrggbb`,
 * gives the terminal's default (`39`, `49`).
 */
export function terminalColor(theme: Theme, role: string, depth: ColorDepth, layer: "fg" | "bg"): string

## Theme  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** A theme: an id, a name, its mode, a colour per role (CSS colours; `#rrggbb` for terminals), web and terminal extras. */
export type Theme = {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly mode: "dark" | "light";
	readonly colors: Readonly<Record<BaseRole, string>> & Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
	/** More CSS variables on `:root`, by name without `--` (`radius`, `font`); URLs of the plugin's assets allowed. */
	readonly web?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
	/** Terminal colours by role, before `colors`: `#rrggbb` or an xterm 256-colour index (`"208"`). */
	readonly tui?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
};

## ThemePick  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The user's choice: a theme id for dark and one for light (`null`: the first contributed of that mode). */
export type ThemePick = { readonly dark: string | null; readonly light: string | null };

## Themes  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The themes plugins contribute, in plugin-name order; served on every client and on the server by the kit. */
export const Themes: Registry<Theme, readonly Theme[]>

## themesFacet  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The kit's facet serving `Themes` on a host: the contributions as they are, in plugin-name order. */
export function themesFacet<P extends Principal>(): Facet<P>

## themeVariables  chord/src/surfaces/themes.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The CSS custom properties of `theme`: `--<role>` for every colour, then `--<name>` for each `web` extra. */
export function themeVariables(theme: Theme): Readonly<Record<string, string>>

## Translation  chord/src/surfaces/translations.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** One catalog: the messages of `namespace` in `locale`; `override: true` replaces the plugin's own for that locale. */
export type Translation = {
	readonly namespace: string;
	readonly locale: string;
	/** Partial allowed: a missing key falls back (the locale's base, then the namespace's first catalog). */
	readonly messages: Catalog;
	readonly override?: true;
};

## TranslationIndex  chord/src/surfaces/translations.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The composed catalogs: the one used per namespace and canonical locale, with its plugin; every locale offered. */
export type TranslationIndex = {
	readonly catalogs: ReadonlyMap<string, ReadonlyMap<string, TableItem<Translation>>>;
	/** Every locale some catalog offers, canonical (`pt-BR`), sorted. */
	readonly locales: readonly string[];
};

## Translations  chord/src/surfaces/translations.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The catalogs plugins contribute, a list per contributor; served on the server, pages and terminals by the kit. */
export const Translations: Registry<readonly Translation[], TranslationIndex>

## translationsFacet  chord/src/surfaces/translations.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The kit's facet serving `Translations` on a host. */
export function translationsFacet<P extends Principal>(): Facet<P>

## ChordSpanName  chord/src/telemetry.ts
used by: chord-effect
/** The names of Chord's spans. */
export type ChordSpanName = TelemetrySchemaSpanName<typeof CHORD_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA>;

## NativeWatchable  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: chord-effect via Self, durable-effect via registryReader
/**
 * An in-process value that changes and can be watched (it may hold anything, errors and functions included): a change
 * is a new value by identity, delivered without ops.
 */
export interface NativeWatchable<T> {
	/** The current value. */
	readonly value: T;
	/** A watch holding the current value, then one frame per new value; aborting the context ends it. */
	watch(context: Context): Promise<NativeWatchHandle<T>>;
}

## NativeWatchCall  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: durable-effect; chord-effect via NativeObserver
/** One call of a native watch's listener: the new value, or a failure its source may recover from, as in `WatchCall`. */
export type NativeWatchCall<T> =
	| { readonly kind: "value"; readonly value: T }
	| { readonly kind: "failed"; readonly error: unknown };

## NativeWatchHandle  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: chord-effect via Self, durable-effect via registryReader
/**
 * Serialized observation of an in-process value: as `WatchHandle`, but each new value is its own call, in order, without
 * ops.
 */
export interface NativeWatchHandle<T> {
	/** Acquisition value before start; latest delivered value afterward (a `failed` call keeps it). */
	readonly value: T;
	/** Install the sole asynchronous listener. Never invokes it inline. */
	start(listener: (call: NativeWatchCall<T>, context: Context) => Promise<void>): void;
	/** Idempotently stop future callbacks and return this watch's terminal result. */
	stop(): Promise<WatchEnd>;
	/** Settle when the watch terminates; an already-running callback remains caller-owned. */
	readonly closed: Promise<WatchEnd>;
}

## Watchable  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: chord-effect
/**
 * A value that changes and can be watched: documents, derives, members of references. Values are immutable by
 * convention (JSON for state); each watch starts at the current value and then gets the changes, folded while its
 * listener is busy.
 */
export interface Watchable<T> {
	/** The current value. */
	readonly value: T;
	/** A watch holding the current value, then its changes; aborting the context ends it. */
	watch(context: Context): Promise<WatchHandle<T>>;
}

## WatchCall  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: durable-effect; chord-effect via FollowObserver, durable-rivet-effect via CompactionTask
/**
 * One call of a JSON watch's listener, and one frame a source hands its watch, tagged by `kind`:
 *
 * - `value`: the newest value, the ops that turn the previous value into it, and whether the document the watch follows
 *   was retired since the previous value call. A retirement does not end the watch: `value` is then what the address
 *   shows after it (the source decides; a Durable document keeps the last value the watch was given, with no ops), and a
 *   document created there later arrives as `[["r", value]]`, possibly in the same call.
 * - `failed`: the source cannot compute its value now, with `error`; the watch stays open, and the next value arrives as
 *   `[["r", value]]`. `WatchHandle.value` keeps the last value.
 *
 * Plain data: the frame's context is the listener's second argument, never part of the call.
 */
export type WatchCall<T> =
	| { readonly kind: "value"; readonly value: T; readonly ops: readonly Op[]; readonly retired: boolean }
	| { readonly kind: "failed"; readonly error: unknown };

## WatchEnd  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: durable-effect; chord-effect via FollowObserver, durable-rivet-effect via CompactionTask
/**
 * Terminal result of one watch, tagged by `kind`. A watch ends only for good; a failure its source recovers from is a
 * `failed` call (`WatchCall`), and the watch stays open.
 *
 * - `stopped`: `stop()` was called.
 * - `aborted`: the context the watch was acquired with was aborted.
 * - `ended`: the source closed (its owner ended or closed).
 * - `listener_error`: the listener threw or rejected with `error`.
 * - `failed`: the source failed for good with `error`.
 */
export type WatchEnd =
	| { readonly kind: "stopped" | "aborted" | "ended" }
	| { readonly kind: "listener_error"; readonly error: Error }
	| { readonly kind: "failed"; readonly error: unknown };

## WatchHandle  chord/src/watch.ts
used by: durable-effect; chord-effect via KeyedWatchable, durable-rivet-effect via CompactionTask
/**
 * Serialized observation of an immutable value: one listener call at a time; changes made meanwhile arrive folded into
 * the next call.
 */
export interface WatchHandle<T> {
	/** Acquisition revision before start; latest delivered immutable revision afterward (a `failed` call keeps it). */
	readonly value: T;
	/** Install the sole asynchronous listener. Never invokes it inline. */
	start(listener: (call: WatchCall<T>, context: Context) => Promise<void>): void;
	/** Idempotently stop future callbacks and return this watch's terminal result. */
	stop(): Promise<WatchEnd>;
	/** Settle when the watch terminates; an already-running callback remains caller-owned. */
	readonly closed: Promise<WatchEnd>;
}
